section.name: TWB Admin Panel
section.description: Internal dashboard for staff to manage live orders, products, and inventory in real time. Not public - internal tool under NDA.
highlights: Built a tabbed modal workflow for editing live orders - catering items, packages, flowers with expandable rows - with in-place add, replace, and delete
Added category search and filtering across the live order catalog
Replaced manual day-to-day operations with a centralized, real-time interface
